translations.translatedText: # Friday 14.2.2020 (radio)

There will be no strike in the retail sector. Finland plans to speed up residence permit processing for foreigners who get a job in Finland. The coronavirus is spreading quickly in China. Friend's Day was celebrated on Friday. Some pupils have started their winter holiday.
## The retail strike is cancelled
![Worker packing online shopping orders at Citymarket Easton](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9950641)
Open image viewer
Work in shops continues, because the strike is cancelled. Photo: Antti Kolppo / Yle
There will be no strike in the retail sector. The employers and the PAM trade union accepted a new collective agreement on Friday.
The collective agreement sets wages and working hours. The new collective agreement raises wages in the retail sector by 3.3 percent.
Because the agreement was reached, the strikes at Prisma and Citymarket will be cancelled.
## Foreign skilled workers are needed
![Background info about Labour Minister Tuula Haatainen](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5275,h_2967,x_0,y_99/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-6427355e4668088d99f/1581672864)
Open image viewer
Labour Minister Tuula Haatainen. Photo: Terhi Liimu / Yle
Finland plans to speed up the processing of residence permits for foreigners who get a job in Finland. The aim is that a residence permit comes within one month.
Labour Minister Tuula Haatainen says that Finnish companies need skilled workers from abroad. For example, Finland needs coders, welders and nurses.
Last year, most work residence permits were given to Ukrainians, Indians and Russians. Citizens of EU countries do not need a residence permit when they come to Finland to work.
## The coronavirus is spreading in China
![Taneli Puumalainen and Mika Salminen from THL at a press conference on Wednesday.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11183321)
Open image viewer
In Finland, experts from THL are following the spread of the coronavirus around the world. Photo: Antti Aimo-Koivisto / Lehtikuva
The coronavirus is spreading quickly in China. About 65,000 Chinese people have already got the coronavirus. The virus has killed about 1400 people.

In other countries there are only a few coronavirus patients. In Europe, the most coronavirus cases have been in Germany, but even there there are fewer than 20. In Finland there has been only one coronavirus patient.
In Finland, the National Institute for Health and Welfare, THL, gives information about the coronavirus. Information about the coronavirus is also available in plain language on the website thl.fi.
THL in plain language
## Friend's Day is celebrated in Finland
![heart-shaped candies](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9506322)
Open image viewer
Photo: AOP
Friend's Day was celebrated on Friday. In many other countries, St Valentine's Day, the feast of love, is celebrated, but in Finland the theme of the day is friendship.
Friend's Day is quite a new holiday in Finland. It got into the calendar in 1987.
In some countries the day has been celebrated for a long time. For example, in England St Valentine's Day has been a holiday since 1537.
## The winter holiday week began in the south
![Man and child skiing.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11179067)
Open image viewer
Many people travel from southern Finland to Lapland to spend their winter holiday. Photo: Juha Heikanen / Yle
Some pupils have started their winter holiday. Next week is winter holiday week in schools in Helsinki and the Turku area. Elsewhere in Finland the winter holiday is later.
The winter holiday in the south starts in autumn-like weather. At the weekend it rains and the wind blows. The temperature in the south is above zero.
Only in Lapland is it frosty, and the rain comes as snow.
